employees.label: Employees
employees.definition: 'The Company employed approximately 234,000 people as of fiscal year end 2026, of which approximately 173,000 were employed in the U.S. and approximately 61,000 were employed outside the U.S.' Includes full-time (77%), part-time (15%) and seasonal (8%) employees.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Human Capital)
source.quote: The Company employed approximately 234,000 people as of fiscal year end 2026, of which approximately 173,000 were employed in the U.S.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Human Capital)
source.quote: approximately 173,000 were employed in the U.S. and approximately 61,000 were employed outside the U.S.

sites.name: Walt Disney World Resort
sites.description: About 25,000 acres southwest of Orlando: Magic Kingdom, EPCOT, Disney's Hollywood Studios and Disney's Animal Kingdom; 18 owned resort hotels and vacation club properties with about 23,000 rooms and 3,900 vacation club units.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Experiences)
source.quote: The Walt Disney World Resort is located approximately 20 miles southwest of Orlando, Florida, on approximately 25,000 acres of land. … As of October 3, 2026, the Company owned and operated 18 resort hotels and vacation club properties at the Walt Disney World Resort, with approximately 23,000 rooms and 3,900 vacation club units.

sites.name: Disneyland Resort
sites.description: About 550 acres in Anaheim with Disneyland and Disney California Adventure, hotels (three resort hotels and vacation club properties, about 2,400 rooms) and Downtown Disney.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Experiences)
source.quote: The Disneyland Resort is located in Anaheim, California on approximately 550 acres of land. The resort includes two theme parks (Disneyland and Disney California Adventure); hotels; and a retail, dining and entertainment complex (Downtown Disney). … As of October 3, 2026, the Company owned and operated three resort hotels and vacation club properties at the Disneyland Resort, with approximately 2,400 rooms and 180 vacation club units.

sites.name: Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa
sites.description: Family resort on a 21 acre oceanfront property with about 350 hotel rooms and about 480 vacation club units.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Experiences)
source.quote: Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, is a family resort on a 21 acre oceanfront property on Oahu, Hawaii featuring approximately 480 vacation club units, 350 hotel rooms

sites.name: Disneyland Paris
sites.description: A 5,200-acre site east of Paris with Disneyland Park, Disney Adventure World (the former Walt Disney Studios Park) and seven resort hotels (about 5,750 rooms).

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Experiences)
source.quote: Disneyland Paris is located approximately 20 miles east of Paris, France in Marne-la-Vallée on a 5,200-acre site … Disneyland Paris' operations include two theme parks (Disneyland Park and Disney Adventure World) … Disneyland Paris operates seven resort hotels, with approximately 5,750 rooms

sites.name: Hong Kong Disneyland Resort
sites.description: 48% owned by Disney (52% by the HKSAR Government); a theme park and hotels on about 310 acres.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Experiences)
source.quote: The Company owns a 48% interest in Hong Kong Disneyland Resort and the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (HKSAR) owns a 52% interest. The resort is located on Lantau Island on approximately 310 acres of land

sites.name: Shanghai Disney Resort
sites.description: 43% owned by Disney (57% by Shendi); Shanghai Disneyland, two themed hotels and Disneytown on about 1,000 acres.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Experiences)
source.quote: The Company owns a 43% interest in Shanghai Disney Resort and Shanghai Shendi (Group) Co., Ltd (Shendi) owns a 57% interest. The resort is located in the Pudong district of Shanghai on approximately 1,000 acres of land

sites.name: Tokyo Disney Resort
sites.description: Owned and operated by Oriental Land Co., a third party; Disney earns royalties. Tokyo Disneyland and Tokyo DisneySea on about 500 acres.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Experiences)
source.quote: Tokyo Disney Resort is located six miles east of downtown Tokyo, Japan, on approximately 500 acres of land. The Company earns royalties on revenues generated by the Tokyo Disney Resort, which is owned and operated by Oriental Land Co., Ltd. (OLC)

sites.name: Disney's Castaway Cay
sites.description: A 1,000-acre private Bahamian island visited by many Disney Cruise Line sailings (eight-ship fleet).

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 1 (Experiences)
source.quote: Disney Cruise Line operates eight ships … Many cruises include a visit to Disney Castaway Cay, a 1,000-acre private Bahamian island

sites.name: Burbank headquarters and studios
sites.description: Owned land (182 acres) and buildings (4,733,000 square feet) in Burbank and surrounding cities: office, production and warehouse.

source.label: FY2026 Form 10-K, Item 2. Properties
source.quote: Burbank, CA & surrounding cities (1) | Land (182 acres) & Buildings (4,733,000 ft 2 ) | Owned Office/Production/Warehouse

notes: Disney's FY2026 10-K (fiscal year ended Oct 3, 2026) gives employees only as U.S. versus outside the U.S. (173,000 and 61,000 of about 234,000); it does not break out employees, investment or taxes by state or country. Sites are the parks and resorts as described in the FY2026 10-K (Item 1, Experiences) plus the Burbank property from Item 2. Hong Kong and Shanghai are joint ventures (Disney 48% and 43%); Tokyo Disney Resort is licensed and owned by Oriental Land Co. The 10-K also names Disney Lookout Cay at Lighthouse Point (about 600 acres on Eleuthera, Bahamas) and a planned Miral-built, Disney-licensed resort in Abu Dhabi; neither is listed as a site. Not checked: Disney-commissioned economic impact studies of individual resorts (e.g. Walt Disney World in Florida), which would be tier company-commissioned. Revenue by geography is in the records and not repeated.
